calibration.camera_height_source: estimate reconciled from the ceiling probe and the stereo scale-free shape ratio; see DEFAULT_CAMERA_HEIGHT_M
calibration.ceiling_probe_note: Observed ceiling height at this assumed camera height. If it disagrees with the real storey height, every dimension is off by the same ratio.

measured_dimensions.note: Single-viewpoint line-of-sight span; occluded extents not captured.
